findings.summary: Hosted integration required by the approved plan is not represented in the frozen verification record.
findings.broken_invariant: The approved plan requires hosted integration, but the recorded verification covers focused tests, evaluator command tests, typecheck, formatting, and diff checks only.

missing_tests: A merge-aware negative test where comparison with the second parent contains only authority, lifecycle, implementation-receipt, or derived managed task artifacts.
A regression test defining behavior for merge commits with more than two parents, or an explicit invariant rejecting unsupported octopus merges.
hidden_assumptions: A branch_pr base-sync merge always has the task branch as first parent and the synchronized base as second parent.
Two-parent merge handling is sufficient for all supported base-sync workflows.
The existing compatibility suite adequately covers lifecycle-only and metadata-only changes when they occur specifically at a base-sync merge head.
